name: Aura Smart Air Ltd
summary: Aura Smart Air Ltd specializes in the design, distribution, and management of advanced air purification and monitoring platforms. Operating both domestically in Israel and across international markets, the company's product portfolio encompasses the Aura Air comprehensive air management system, the compact Aura Air Mini portable purifier, and the Aura web platform, which delivers crucial insights into both indoor and outdoor air quality. Their innovative solutions are deployed across various industries, notably education, transportation, and government. Established in 2018, Aura Smart Air Ltd maintains its headquarters in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
